description: This file provides a function named get_html_translation_table, which generates an associative array mapping characters to HTML entities based on specified table and quote style options. It appears to be a utility script for HTML entity translation, originally from the phpjs.org project, with extensive license and attribution comments.

methods.name: get_html_translation_table(table,quote_style)
methods.description: Generates a translation table mapping characters to HTML entities based on specified table and quote style parameters.
